title: The C API
text: Every function can fail returns zb_status, ZB_OK (0) success; results come back -parameters. failure inputs unchanged: cursor returns ZB_ERR_EOF moved, buffer returns ZB_ERR_LIMIT holds held. Nothing headers prints, aborts, exits allocates, except buf.h, malloc, realloc free.

title: The C API
text: cursor pointer, length 0-based position, every error reader reports “byte c.pos”. One read per type byte order: zb_cur_u32le(), zb_cur_f64be(), zb_cur_bytes() borrow run bytes, zb_cur_seek() zb_cur_skip().
code: /* Translation unit 2: a checked sequential read of a header. Includes one    area header, then the umbrella, the two ways the README allows. */ #include <zubin/cursor.h> #include <zubin.h> #include "zubintest.h"  /* magic:u32be version:u16le count:u32le name:6 bytes; returns c(magic,    version, count, the position after the header), or the status's name and    the position where the read failed. */ SEXP zt_header(SEXP x) {     zb_cur c;     uint32_t magic = 0, count = 0;     uint16_t version = 0;     const uint8_t *name = NULL;     zb_status st;     SEXP out;     zb_cur_init(&c, XLENGTH(x) ? RAW(x) : NULL, (size_t)XLENGTH(x));     if ((st = zb_cur_u32be(&c, &magic)) || (st = zb_cur_u16le(&c, &version)) ||         (st = zb_cur_u32le(&c, &count)) || (st = zb_cur_bytes(&c, &name, 6))) {         out = PROTECT(Rf_allocVector(STRSXP, 2));         SET_STRING_ELT(out, 0, Rf_mkChar(zb_status_string(st)));         SET_STRING_ELT(out, 1, Rf_mkChar(c.pos == 0 ? "0" : c.pos == 4 ? "4" : c.pos == 6 ? "6" : "10"));         UNPROTECT(1);         return out;     }     out = Rf_allocVector(REALSXP, 4);     REAL(out)[0] = magic;     REAL(out)[1] = version;     REAL(out)[2] = count;     REAL(out)[3] = (double)c.pos;     return out; }

title: The C API
text: layout parsed specification string bin_layout() takes, field array caller supplies, parser allocates nothing. Size array zb_layout_count_fields(); names result borrowed pointers specification, must outlive layout. kernels process one field n records one strided loop, one typed column: zb_unpack_i32() small integer types bool, zb_unpack_f64() u32 floating types, zb_unpack_i64() zb_unpack_f64x() (exact error) 64-bit integers, zb_unpack_bytes() b s. Array fields written column-major, element k record dst[k * n + ]. zb_pack_*() kernels inverses, refuse value fit rather wrapping . kernels bounds-check: prove offset + (n - 1) * stride + size <= length first.
code: /* Translation unit 1: parse a layout and unpack records with its kernels.    Includes the umbrella header. */ #include <zubin.h> #include "zubintest.h"  /* Every numeric field of every whole record of x, as doubles, one list    element per field; or the status's name when the spec is malformed. */ SEXP zt_unpack(SEXP spec, SEXP x) {     const char *s = CHAR(STRING_ELT(spec, 0));     size_t n = strlen(s), pos = 0, len = (size_t)XLENGTH(x), nrec;     uint32_t nf = zb_layout_count_fields(s, n), j;     zb_field *fields = (zb_field *)R_alloc(nf, sizeof(zb_field));     zb_layout l;     zb_status st = zb_layout_parse(s, n, 0, 0, fields, nf, &l, &pos);     SEXP out;     if (st) return Rf_mkString(zb_status_string(st));     nrec = len / l.size;     out = PROTECT(Rf_allocVector(VECSXP, l.nfields));     for (j = 0; j < l.nfields; j++) {         const zb_field *f = &l.fields[j];         size_t bad = 0, i;         SEXP col = Rf_allocVector(REALSXP, (R_xlen_t)(nrec * f->count));         SET_VECTOR_ELT(out, j, col);         if (zb_unpack_f64(RAW(x), nrec, l.size, f, REAL(col)) == ZB_OK) continue;         if (zb_unpack_f64x(RAW(x), nrec, l.size, f, REAL(col), &bad) == ZB_OK) continue;         {             int32_t *tmp = (int32_t *)R_alloc(nrec * f->count + 1, sizeof(int32_t));             if (zb_unpack_i32(RAW(x), nrec, l.size, f, tmp, 1, &bad) == ZB_OK) {                 for (i = 0; i < nrec * f->count; i++) REAL(col)[i] = tmp[i];                 continue;             }         }         SET_VECTOR_ELT(out, j, R_NilValue);   /* b, s, x: not numbers */     }     UNPROTECT(1);     return out; }

what: Writing: the buffer, and buffers owned by R
title: The C API
text: zb_buf pointer, length, capacity, hard cap max (0 none), flags, release function owner frees: shape Arrow C data interface. zb_buf_alloc() makes growable buffer, zb_buf_borrow() window onto memory (writable length, never grown), zb_buf_release() frees whatever needs freeing. Growth doubles 64 MiB grows half , never past max: append ZB_ERR_LIMIT, sets ZB_BUF_HIT_LIMIT, changes nothing. bare size arithmetic: sums products overflow ZB_ERR_MEMORY. Ownership flag, never identity release: every translation unit copy header-function, comparing function pointers across units meaningless. R package, heap memory must survive longjmp Rf_error() R_CheckUserInterrupt() must owned R first call can jump. zb_r_buf_new() creates external pointer registers finalizer buffer exists; zb_r_buf_free() releases early, finalizer nothing: zb_r_buf_get() allocates nothing, nothing needs protecting around , returns NULL external pointer one buffers freed (one restored saved session, say).
code: /* Translation unit 3: a buffer owned by R, through <zubin-r.h>. */ #include <zubin-r.h> #include "zubintest.h"  /* Appends the doubles in `values` as f32be, then borrows the raw vector    `tail` and appends its bytes, and returns the buffer's bytes. The buffer is    owned by an external pointer from before it exists, so the error below    cannot leak it. */ SEXP zt_build(SEXP values, SEXP tail) {     zb_status st;     zb_buf view, *b;     R_xlen_t i;     SEXP out, ptr = PROTECT(zb_r_buf_new(16, 1 << 20, &st));     if (st) Rf_error("zt_build: %s", zb_status_string(st));     b = zb_r_buf_get(ptr);     for (i = 0; i < XLENGTH(values); i++) {         if (zb_put_f32be(b, (float)REAL(values)[i])) Rf_error("zt_build: put failed");     }     zb_r_buf_borrow(&view, tail);     if (zb_put_bytes(b, view.data, view.len)) Rf_error("zt_build: the cap was reached");     out = PROTECT(zb_r_buf_to_raw(b));     zb_r_buf_free(ptr);     UNPROTECT(2);     return out; }

what: Writing and reading a WAV file
title: Structured binary data with zubin
text: bin_encode() turns vector bytes one type, one second 440 Hz tone 16-bit samples, bin_pack() writes one header record named values. Reading back two steps reverse: header one-row data frame, samples byte .
code: samples <- bin_encode(round(32767 * sin(2 * pi * 440 * seq(0, 1, by = 1 / 8000))), "i16") hdr <- bin_pack(wav, riff = "RIFF", size = 36 + length(samples), wave = "WAVE",                 fmt = "fmt ", fmt_size = 16, format = 1, channels = 1, rate = 8000,                 byte_rate = 16000, block_align = 2, bits = 16, data = "data",                 data_size = length(samples)) path <- tempfile(fileext = ".wav") writeBin(c(hdr, samples), path) x <- readBin(path, "raw", file.size(path)) h <- bin_unpack(x, wav, n = 1) h[, c("channels", "rate", "bits", "data_size")] #>   channels rate bits data_size #> 1        1 8000   16     16002 pcm <- bin_decode(x, "i16", offset = bin_size(wav), n = h$data_size / 2) head(pcm) #> [1]     0 11099 20886 28204 32187 32364 bin_hexdump(x, n = 48) #> 00000000: 5249 4646 a63e 0000 5741 5645 666d 7420  RIFF.>..WAVEfmt  #> 00000010: 1000 0000 0100 0100 401f 0000 803e 0000  ........@....>.. #> 00000020: 0200 1000 6461 7461 823e 0000 0000 5b2b  ....data.>....[+

title: Structured binary data with zubin
text: file records behind header, built byte builder, grows without copying everything append: bin_put() also encodes vectors directly, writer whole records hand appends field field: bin_put(b, x, type = "f32", endian = "big"). Strings append C strings (type = "z") fixed fields (type = "s16").
code: hdr <- bin_layout(">magic:u32 version:u16 count:u32") rec <- bin_layout(">id:u32 ts:i64 price:f64 qty:i32 side:u8 x3") trades <- data.frame(id = 1:4, ts = 1.7e12 + c(0, 15, 40, 41),                      price = c(101.5, 101.25, 101.75, 101.5),                      qty = c(100L, 50L, 75L, 10L), side = c(1L, 2L, 1L, 2L))  b <- bin_builder() bin_put(b, bin_pack(hdr, magic = 0xCAFEBABE, version = 1, count = nrow(trades))) bin_put(b, bin_pack(rec, trades)) b #> <zubin_builder: 122 bytes, capacity 256, max none> path <- tempfile() writeBin(bin_take(b), path) x <- readBin(path, "raw", file.size(path)) h <- bin_unpack(x, hdr, n = 1) h$magic == 0xCAFEBABE #> [1] TRUE bin_unpack(x, rec, offset = bin_size(hdr), n = h$count) #>   id      ts  price qty side #> 1  1 1.7e+12 101.50 100    1 #> 2  2 1.7e+12 101.25  50    2 #> 3  3 1.7e+12 101.75  75    1 #> 4  4 1.7e+12 101.50  10    2

DESCRIPTION: list zubin zufast LinkingTo, nothing else: Imports:, importFrom(), configure, PKG_LIBS. , LinkingTo transitive zubin’s headers include zufast’s. Neither needed package runs: shared object carries copy every zubin function uses, keeps working removed. 2. NAMESPACE: useDynLib. 3. src/Makevars: hide symbols, zu family . Every function zubin emits already static inline, two packages use zubin never bind ’s copies; defence depth. 4. Include call. <zubin.h> everything, one area time (<zubin/cursor.h>, <zubin/buf.h>, <zubin/layout.h>, …). number translation units may include ; nothing link implementation macro. compile C99 C++11. checked sequential read header: Every function can fail returns zb_status (ZB_OK 0), failure inputs unchanged: cursor returns ZB_ERR_EOF moved. 5. Buffers owned R. <zubin-r.h> one header includes R’s, part <zubin.h>. zb_r_buf_new() hands buffer owned external pointer whose finalizer registered buffer exists, Rf_error() interrupt leak : C API, buffer ownership layout kernels described c-api article package website.
code: LinkingTo: zubin, zufast useDynLib(zubintest, .registration = TRUE) PKG_CFLAGS = $(C_VISIBILITY) /* Translation unit 2: a checked sequential read of a header. Includes one    area header, then the umbrella, the two ways the README allows. */ #include <zubin/cursor.h> #include <zubin.h> #include "zubintest.h"  /* magic:u32be version:u16le count:u32le name:6 bytes; returns c(magic,    version, count, the position after the header), or the status's name and    the position where the read failed. */ SEXP zt_header(SEXP x) {     zb_cur c;     uint32_t magic = 0, count = 0;     uint16_t version = 0;     const uint8_t *name = NULL;     zb_status st;     SEXP out;     zb_cur_init(&c, XLENGTH(x) ? RAW(x) : NULL, (size_t)XLENGTH(x));     if ((st = zb_cur_u32be(&c, &magic)) || (st = zb_cur_u16le(&c, &version)) ||         (st = zb_cur_u32le(&c, &count)) || (st = zb_cur_bytes(&c, &name, 6))) {         out = PROTECT(Rf_allocVector(STRSXP, 2));         SET_STRING_ELT(out, 0, Rf_mkChar(zb_status_string(st)));         SET_STRING_ELT(out, 1, Rf_mkChar(c.pos == 0 ? "0" : c.pos == 4 ? "4" : c.pos == 6 ? "6" : "10"));         UNPROTECT(1);         return out;     }     out = Rf_allocVector(REALSXP, 4);     REAL(out)[0] = magic;     REAL(out)[1] = version;     REAL(out)[2] = count;     REAL(out)[3] = (double)c.pos;     return out; } /* Translation unit 3: a buffer owned by R, through <zubin-r.h>. */ #include <zubin-r.h> #include "zubintest.h"  /* Appends the doubles in `values` as f32be, then borrows the raw vector    `tail` and appends its bytes, and returns the buffer's bytes. The buffer is    owned by an external pointer from before it exists, so the error below    cannot leak it. */ SEXP zt_build(SEXP values, SEXP tail) {     zb_status st;     zb_buf view, *b;     R_xlen_t i;     SEXP out, ptr = PROTECT(zb_r_buf_new(16, 1 << 20, &st));     if (st) Rf_error("zt_build: %s", zb_status_string(st));     b = zb_r_buf_get(ptr);     for (i = 0; i < XLENGTH(values); i++) {         if (zb_put_f32be(b, (float)REAL(values)[i])) Rf_error("zt_build: put failed");     }     zb_r_buf_borrow(&view, tail);     if (zb_put_bytes(b, view.data, view.len)) Rf_error("zt_build: the cap was reached");     out = PROTECT(zb_r_buf_to_raw(b));     zb_r_buf_free(ptr);     UNPROTECT(2);     return out; }

title: zubin 0.0.0.9000
text: Seventeen functions, prefixed bin_: bin_layout() describes fixed-size binary record one-line specification (integers 8 64 bits, f16, bf16, f32, f64, bool, fixed bytes strings, padding, arrays, either byte order, C struct alignment); bin_unpack() bin_pack() read write number records one call; bin_decode() bin_encode() convert whole vectors bytes one type; bin_builder(), bin_put(), bin_reserve(), bin_reset() bin_take() append growable byte buffer hard cap; bin_size(); bin_hexdump() bin_diff(); bin_info(). bin_serialize() appends R’s serialization object builder, without first allocating raw vector; bin_unserialize() reads one raw vector 0-based offset; bin_hash_object() gives XXH3 fingerprint object change R version, streamed serialization never allocated (#25). Nothing silently wrong: value fit field, NA bytes, 64-bit integer double hold exactly, string UTF-8 classed error naming field 0-based record (?zubin-conditions).

title: zubin 0.0.0.9000
text: header-C99 library inst/include, used LinkingTo: zubin, zufast alone: zubin/rw.h (typed reads writes alignment byte order), zubin/cursor.h (checked sequential reads), zubin/buf.h (buffer ownership flags, hard cap checked growth), zubin/layout.h (specification parser field-major unpack pack kernels), zubin-r.h (buffer owned R external pointer). Source compatibility within major version 1; see c-api article package website “Using zubin C” README. zubin-r.h also points R’s serialization containers: zb_serialize() buffer, zb_unserialize() cursor, zb_serialize_to_sink() sink, block pipeline consumes (#25). R’s errors reach caller unchanged; stream runs builder grow statuses.
